body:
A recipe declares its target platforms (e.g. Linux `deb`/`appimage`, macOS `dmg`/`app`, Windows `msi`), each with the steps that differ.

- Each target shows as its own step on the Build tab.
- One release holds every target's artifacts, all under one version.
- A build makes only the targets the local PC can make. The others don't fail the build.
- Solace's own desktop recipe declares Linux, macOS and Windows targets.

Done when: on Linux, Solace's own build shows its targets as separate steps and passes, and the release holds the Linux bundles.
title: targets: declare platforms in a recipe
